raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
### What does this PR do?

`calculate_sum_pi_squared_from_logits` computes `exp(logsumexp(2 * logits) - 2 * logsumexp(logits))` over the whole packed micro-batch in one pass. It is used by `actor.calculate_sum_pi_squared=True`, which optimal token baseline needs. Both `2 * logits` and the `logsumexp` temporaries are full-vocabulary tensors the size of the logits, so on top of the logits themselves the call needs about two more copies of them. With a 152k vocabulary this is the step that runs out of memory on a 24 GB card at the default `log_prob_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=16`, while the same run without `calculate_sum_pi_squared` fits. I hit this while validating #8364.

This PR processes the rows in chunks (default 2048, the same default as `entropy_from_logits_with_chunking`) and concatenates the per-row results. The values and dtype stay the same, the signature only gains an optional `chunk_size`, and gradients still flow. No config change.

**Not a duplicate:** I searched PRs and issues for `calculate_sum_pi_squared_from_logits`, `sum_pi_squared memory` and `sum_pi_squared OOM`. Only #6153 (which added the function) and #8364 (V1 wiring, independent of this change) came up.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs. Paste at least one query link here: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=sum_pi_squared
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}` (This will be checked by the CI)

### Test

**Unit tests:** `tests/utils/test_torch_functional.py` gains `test_calculate_sum_pi_squared_from_logits_chunking`. It compares values and gradients against the softmax-squared reference for 2-D, 3-D and empty inputs at `chunk_size` 1, 4 and 2048. The existing tests are unchanged.

```
pytest -q tests/utils/test_torch_functional.py -k sum_pi_squared
# 16 passed
```

**Memory and time:** RTX 4090, vocab 151936. The reported peak is the extra memory allocated during the call, on top of the input logits. Each time is the mean of 3 calls. The outputs are bitwise identical (max |diff| = 0).

| rows × vocab | dtype | main: extra peak | this PR: extra peak | main time | this PR time |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4096 × 151936 | fp32 | 4.64 GiB | 2.32 GiB | 78 ms | 40 ms |
| 8192 × 151936 | fp32 | 9.27 GiB | 2.32 GiB | 91 ms | 80 ms |
| 8192 × 151936 | bf16 | 4.64 GiB | 1.16 GiB | 40 ms | 41 ms |

**End to end:** V1 trainer with #8364 applied, Qwen3-0.6B, GSM8K, batch 32 × n=4, `optimal_token_baseline`, `calculate_sum_pi_squared=True`, default `log_prob_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=16`:
- without this PR: step 2 fails with `OutOfMemoryError: Tried to allocate 5.29 GiB` inside `calculate_sum_pi_squared_from_logits`;
- with this PR: 3/3 steps complete, `rollout_probs_diff_mean` 0.0057 / 0.0058 / 0.0055.

### Design & Code Changes

`verl/utils/torch_functional.py::calculate_sum_pi_squared_from_logits`:
- flatten the leading dimensions;
- evaluate the same formula per `chunk_size` rows;
- `torch.cat` the results and reshape back;
- return an empty tensor for zero rows.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [ ] Read the [Contribute Guide](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Apply [pre-commit checks](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-linting-and-formatting): `pre-commit install && pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure --color=always`
- [ ] Add / Update [the documentation](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/tree/main/docs).
- [x] Add unit or end-to-end test(s) to [the CI workflow](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/tree/main/.github/workflows) to cover all the code. If not feasible, explain why: covered by `tests/utils/test_torch_functional.py`, which runs in the GPU unit test workflow (the new test itself runs on CPU).
- [ ] Once your PR is ready for CI, send a message in [the `ci-request` channel](https://verl-project.slack.com/archives/C091TCESWB1) in [the `verl` Slack workspace](https://join.slack.com/t/verl-project/shared_invite/zt-3855yhg8g-CTkqXu~hKojPCmo7k_yXTQ). files.patch:
@@ -150,6 +150,29 @@ def test_calculate_sum_pi_squared_from_logits_extreme_values():
     torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, atol=1e-10, rtol=1e-10)
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("shape", [(10, 33), (3, 7, 33), (0, 33)])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("chunk_size", [1, 4, 2048])
+def test_calculate_sum_pi_squared_from_logits_chunking(shape, chunk_size):
+    """Chunked rows give the same values and gradients as a single pass."""
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    logits = (torch.randn(*shape, dtype=torch.float64) * 5.0).requires_grad_()
+    expected = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1).pow(2).sum(dim=-1)
+
+    actual = calculate_sum_pi_squared_from_logits(logits, chunk_size=chunk_size)
+
+    assert actual.shape == expected.shape
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, atol=1e-10, rtol=1e-10)
+    (grad,) = torch.autograd.grad(actual.sum(), logits)
+    (expected_grad,) = torch.autograd.grad(expected.sum(), logits)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(grad, expected_grad, atol=1e-10, rtol=1e-10)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("chunk_size", [0, -1])
+def test_calculate_sum_pi_squared_from_logits_rejects_non_positive_chunk_size(chunk_size):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="chunk_size"):
+        calculate_sum_pi_squared_from_logits(torch.randn(4, 8), chunk_size=chunk_size)
+
+
 def test_expand_as_nested():
     a = torch.randn(2)
     b = torch.randn(3)

@@ -684,21 +684,37 @@ def post_process_logits(input_ids, logits, temperature, top_k, top_p):
     return logits
 
 
-def calculate_sum_pi_squared_from_logits(logits: torch.Tensor):
+def calculate_sum_pi_squared_from_logits(logits: torch.Tensor, chunk_size: int = 2048):
     """
     Compute exact sum of squared probabilities from logits.
     Formula: Σπ² = exp(logsumexp(2*logits) - 2*logsumexp(logits))
 
     Used for optimal baseline variance reduction as described in
     "What Matters for Model Merging at Scale?" (arXiv:2410.03617)
 
+    Rows are processed ``chunk_size`` at a time: ``2 * logits`` and the ``logsumexp`` intermediates are each as
+    large as the input, so computing them for a whole packed micro-batch at once can need several extra GB.
+
     Args:
         logits: Logits tensor (..., vocab_size).
+        chunk_size: Number of rows (positions) processed at once.
 
     Returns:
         Sum of squared probabilities tensor (...).
     """
-    return torch.exp(torch.logsumexp(2.0 * logits, dim=-1) - 2.0 * torch.logsumexp(logits, dim=-1))
+    if chunk_size <= 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"chunk_size must be positive, got {chunk_size}")
+
+    def _sum_pi_squared(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return torch.exp(torch.logsumexp(2.0 * x, dim=-1) - 2.0 * torch.logsumexp(x, dim=-1))
+
+    flat_logits = logits.reshape(-1, logits.shape[-1])
+    if flat_logits.shape[0] <= chunk_size:
+        return _sum_pi_squared(logits)
+    chunks = [
+        _sum_pi_squared(flat_logits[start : start + chunk_size]) for start in range(0, flat_logits.shape[0], chunk_size)
+    ]
+    return torch.cat(chunks).reshape(logits.shape[:-1])
